title.zh: 将孔波斯特拉谷省 Maragusan 市镇 Langgawisan 描笼涯的 Maragusan 国立中学的 Langgawisan附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Maragusan National High School - Langgawisan Annex in Barangay Langgawisan, Municipality of Maragusan, Province of Compostela Valley from the Maragusan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Langgawisan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Maragusan National High School - Langgawisan Annex in Barangay Langgawisan, Municipality of Maragusan, Province of Compostela Valley from the Maragusan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Langgawisan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Langgawisan của Trường Trung học Maragusan Quốc gia tại Barangay Langgawisan, Đô thị Maragusan, Tỉnh Compostela Valley khỏi Trường Trung học Maragusan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Langgawisan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Langgawisan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Maragusan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Langgawisan เทศบาล Maragusan จังหวัด Compostela Valley ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Maragusan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Langgawisan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Langgawisan, Sekolah Menengah Maragusan Nasional di Barangay Langgawisan, Kotamadya Maragusan, Provinsi Compostela Valley dari Sekolah Menengah Maragusan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Langgawisan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Langgawisan, Sekolah Menengah Maragusan Kebangsaan di Barangay Langgawisan, Perbandaran Maragusan, Wilayah Compostela Valley daripada Sekolah Menengah Maragusan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Langgawisan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Maragusan National High School - Langgawisan Annex in Barangay Langgawisan, Municipality of Maragusan, Province of Compostela Valley is hereby separated from the Maragusan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Langgawisan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Maragusan National High School - Langgawisan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Langgawisan National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Langgawisan National High School, the "initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Maragusan National High School - Langgawisan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after ita publication in the Official Gazette.
